body.name: Uniform micro-SCG front-door criterion family
body.construction: \(\mathfrak F_{\mathrm{FD}}(H,L,\mathcal A,X,Y,\gamma)=\{c=(b,\mathcal D,\mathcal B):b\in\mathbb N_0,\ \varnothing\ne\mathcal D\subseteq(V\setminus\{X,Y\})\times[-b,0],\ \mathcal B\subseteq(V\setminus\{Y\})\times[-b,0],\text{ and for every }R\in\mathfrak R(H,L),\text{ (i) }\mathcal D\text{ meets every proper directed path from }X_{-\gamma}\text{ to }Y_0,\text{ (ii) }\mathcal B\text{ m-separates }X_{-\gamma}\text{ from }\mathcal D\text{ after deleting arrows out of }X_{-\gamma},\text{ (iii) }\mathcal B\cup\{X_{-\gamma}\}\text{ m-separates }\mathcal D\text{ from }Y_0\text{ after deleting arrows out of }\mathcal D,\text{ and (iv) no role in }\mathcal B\text{ is a descendant of }X_{-\gamma}\}\). The same finite role templates \(\mathcal D,\mathcal B\) are used in every refinement, so their generalized front-door sums are expressions in \(\mathcal L_{\mathrm{cyl}}(\mathcal A)\).
